about_the_game:
Game Introduction

RenXia is a low-fantasy, realistic wuxia-themed action RPG set in ancient China. Players take on the role of young swordsman Yang Che, who enters a martial arts tournament to find a cure for his injured senior brother. There, he must engage in intense combat against other warriors, each driven by their own powerful personal desires.

The combat experience emphasizes hardcore, real-time tactical dueling—every move and every strike matters as you react to your opponent's attacks. Players will face multiple challenging enemies and enjoy a series of thrilling, engaging battles. Meanwhile, the story unfolds through the perspectives of various martial artists, allowing players to appreciate the unique narratives of different warriors, and through them, explore diverse interpretations of chivalry and traditional Chinese culture.

Game Background

In the East lies an ancient kingdom known as the Northern Realm, a nation founded upon the way of martial arts, where every citizen practices combat skills. From nobles and aristocrats to farmers in the fields, all dedicate themselves to the martial path. Across the land, training halls and martial schools stand in great numbers. Warriors bond through combat and travel as chivalrous wanderers, their blades, spears, swords, and halberds clashing endlessly.

This national ethos has given rise to spectacular arena competitions held across the realm. In every prefecture and city, annual tournaments produce brilliant heroes and lively spectacles. Most grand of all, once every five years in the capital, the "Greatest Under Heaven Martial Arts Championship" convenes, gathering the finest warriors in an awe-inspiring display of skill.

Should one claim victory in this championship, they earn the adoration of ten thousand—a glory beyond words. Even more, they may enter the palace to meet the Emperor and have one wish granted. High official positions, peerless martial arts techniques, miraculous medicines—all are within the Emperor's bestowal.

The tale of RenXia begins here.

Game Features

  • A wuxia story experience rich with Chinese characteristics!

  • Intense, high-difficulty action combat that keeps you on edge!

  • Offensive and defensive clashes between multiple weapon types!

Development Team

RenXia is being developed by a team of two—one full-time, one part-time. From the project's inception to its completion, the team has adhered firmly to three principles: accepting no outside investment, keeping the team as small as possible, and maximizing creative freedom.
